title: Bilateral Filter
text: 2-D bilateral filtering, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Neighborhood size} sets Size of image region to average; {Spatial standard deviation}, {Intensity standard deviation}, {Padding method} sets the method for padding boundary of input image, {Padding value} sets the value used to pad boundary of input image, {Line buffer size} sets the size of line memory buffer, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow mode for internal fixed-point, {Coefficients} sets the method to determine data type of filter coefficients and {Output} sets the method to determine data type of output pixels. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

params.name: Neighborhood size
params.values: Size of image region to average 3×3 (default) | 5×5 | 7×7 | 9×9 | 11×11 | 13×13 | 15×15

params.name: Spatial standard deviation
params.values: Spatial standard deviation target 0.5 (default) | positive real number

params.name: Intensity standard deviation
params.values: Intensity standard deviation target 0.5 (default) | positive real number

params.name: Padding method
params.values: Method for padding boundary of input image Constant (default) | Replicate | Symmetric | Reflection | None

params.name: Padding value
params.values: Value used to pad boundary of input image 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Line buffer size
params.values: Size of line memory buffer 2048 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow mode for internal fixed-point calculations on (default) | off

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Method to determine data type of filter coefficients Inherit: Same as first input (default) | fixdt(1,16,0) | data type expression

params.name: Output
params.values: Method to determine data type of output pixels Inherit: Same as first input (default) | fixdt(1,16,0) | data type expression
